description: This file is a PHP class for an admin controller named PromoteSubController, which manages project promotion and highlighting functionalities within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It handles actions such as adding, editing, listing, activating/deactivating, and removing promoted projects, including permission checks and event logging.

classes.name: PromoteSubController
classes.description: Controller for managing project promotion features in the admin panel, including add/edit/list and activation/deactivation of promoted projects.

methods.name: checkItemPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to manage a specific promote item based on its ID.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing an existing promoted project, including permission checks, form processing, and updating project info.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding a new project to the promotion list, including creating promote objects, permission checks, and logging activities.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of all promoted projects within the current node.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a promoted project up in the list order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a promoted project down in the list order.

methods.name: activeAction
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a promoted project.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Removes a project from the promoted list.
